meta.name: histolab
meta.description: Lightweight WSI tile extraction and preprocessing. Use for basic slide processing, tissue detection, tile extraction, and stain normalization for H&E images. Best for simple pipelines, dataset preparation, and quick tile-based analysis. For advanced spatial proteomics, multiplexed imaging, or deep learning pipelines use pathml.

copy.tagline: 从病理切片中提取组织块并预处理图像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理H&E染色切片并提取组织块用于下游分析
copy.tagline_en: Extract tissue tiles from pathology slides and preprocess images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with H&E stained slides and need to extract tissue tiles for downstream analysis

howto.what: Claude 会根据 histolab 库帮你处理病理全切片图像：加载切片、识别组织区域、切成小图块（随机/网格/按评分），并统一染色颜色。
howto.when: 当你想处理病理全切片图像，比如做组织检测、提取图块、染色归一化等操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这张切片随机切成100个512×512的小图块
say.note: 用 RandomTiler 提取，结果存到输出文件夹。

say.text: 用网格方式把整个组织区域都切成图块
say.note: 用 GridTiler 做全覆盖提取。

say.text: 按细胞核密度给图块打分，取前50个保存

howto.what_en: Claude will help you process whole-slide pathology images using histolab: load slides, detect tissue regions, extract tiles (random/grid/scored), and normalize staining.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to process whole-slide images, e.g., tissue detection, tile extraction, stain normalization, or dataset preparation.

say_en.text: Help me randomly extract 100 512x512 tiles from this slide.
say_en.note: Uses RandomTiler, saves to output folder.

say_en.text: Tile the entire tissue region in a grid pattern.
Score tiles by nuclei density and keep the top 50.
